awards_draft#u3.detail: Verified online (AP 16 Apr 2026; reporting through Aug 2026, no 2026-27 change found): 65 games with 20+ min in 63 and 15-20 min allowed in two; governs MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA, All-Defensive; ROY, Sixth Man, All-Rookie exempt; Extraordinary Circumstances challenge granted Doncic (64 g) and Cunningham (63 g), denied Edwards. Added new input nba.eligibility_appeal_grant_model to awards_draft stage s1 (description rewritten to verified facts); patched measurement of nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger and nba.games_played_eligibility (input_patches/NBA_a.json). Clutch coverage left flagged as unconfirmed.

awards_draft#u5.detail: Verified (NBA 2026 format release, NBA.com/NBC coverage): starters 50/25/25 fan/player/media and positionless (fan vote breaks ties), coaches pick 7 reserves per conference without regard to position, Commissioner adds players if voting misses 16 US / 8 international. Both the reserve and the starter inputs wrongly used position slots: patched label/mechanism/measurement of nba.allstar_reserve_coach_vote and nba.allstar_fan_vote_composite; added nba.allstar_nationality_quota to awards_draft stage s6 (renamed, rewritten) and its data set. 2027 format marked pending.

awards_draft#u6.detail: Verified from NBA.com Hustle Award releases (2021-2026): winner chosen by formula over nine per-minute hustle categories (deflections, charges, screen assists, contested 2s and 3s, off/def loose balls, off/def box-outs); weights unpublished. Added nba.hustle_stat_index (fitted rank-ordered weights, qualification floor, projection) as new stage s9 'Formula-decided Hustle Award' in awards_draft with a new hustle-tracking required_data set. Teammate/Sportsmanship stay on the nominee model.

off_court_events#u4.detail: Verified: Board of Governors on 25 Mar 2026 approved exploring Las Vegas and Seattle (23 of 30 needed), final vote later, 2028-29 target, Memphis or Minnesota likely to move East. Added nba.expansion_realignment_joint_tree (expansion vote -> realignment and moving-team pmf -> Europe announcement on one Board calendar) to off_court_events stage s3 and required_data[3], plus a conditional interaction with nba.governance_approval_pipeline. NBA Europe's current status was not found online and stays a tree node, not a verified fact.

parlay_combo#u7.detail: The NHL catalog has no single title input; the Stanley Cup probability is composed from nhl.season_sim_distribution (seeds), nhl.bracket_path_difficulty (bracket) and nhl.series_context (series). Patched nba.cross_league_title_combo measurement to read those NHL ids by name with as-of alignment (both legs from the same nightly run, as-of = min timestamp); KXNBANHL rules text (both must win; early No on elimination) re-read.

player_availability#u2.detail: Defect not real as stated. Rules text and the Kalshi API (KXNBASTARTERS-26OCTMIN-*, finalized) show KXNBASTARTERS is a single-game contract: start the first 2026-27 regular-season game and be on the floor at opening tip, announced-but-not-starting = No. So a game-level starter mechanism is live, and the catalog label 'starting lineup / player availability' fits; KXNBARETURN/KXNBACOMPETE are the season-level ones. No game-by-game starter series is listed. Clarified stage s2 of the player_availability record to say this.

player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.detail: Verified via Kalshi API (series KXNBABENCHPTS, 8 Nov 2026): BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT terms, scope 'Bench Points', settlement ESPN/NBA, no markets listed: a team stat. Added stage s7 to the player_points record that models it with the team-level inputs nba.team_bench_points_model and nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger (fed by required_data[3]), not the player ladder. Caveat: the ticker's archetype in series_assignment.json (read-only here) still says player_points; a move to game_overtime_and_team_events beside KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS is left to the reconcile owner.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.detail: Re-read rules: KXNBA2H includes OT, KXNBA2HWINNER excludes it. Added new input nba.second_half_reg_ot_joint_margin (one simulated game gives M2H_reg = regulation 2H margin and M2H_ot = M2H_reg + OT margins drawn from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin only when regulation ends tied) to stage s6 of quarter_and_half_markets and required_data[0].

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.detail: Re-verified on the Kalshi API 8 Nov 2026: KXNBA2H markets for 9 Nov games close 12 Nov 03:00Z with early close 'after a winner is declared', so they trade in play. Added nba.live_period_state (score, period-start score, clock, on-court fives, team fouls/bonus, timeouts from cdn.nba.com liveData, quote-aligned timestamps) as new stage s7 'In-play conditioning' in quarter_and_half_markets with a live-capture required_data set.

season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.detail: Verified the tiebreak order on the NBA.com standings page (2025-26): two-team head-to-head, division leader, division record, conference record, playoff-eligible own/other conference, net points; multi-team with division leader first. Patched nba.tiebreak_ledger measurement to code that order; patched nba.division_race_tiebreak_state label/mechanism/measurement to a view of nba.tiebreak_ledger inside nba.standings_sim; set its audit verdict to DUPLICATE_OF:nba.tiebreak_ledger in the counting-specials record, the only one auditing it.

season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.detail: season_stat_markets already had stage s5 using nba.standings_sim, but the streak inputs were not defined on it. Patched nba.standings_sim measurement to be the one shared stored game-level season-path simulation read by season_futures_team and season_stat_markets, and nba.team_win_streak_hazard to be a view of those paths (exact DP kept as a check); nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model already simulates from nba.standings_sim.

series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.detail: Decision recorded in the series_and_cup record: Cup contracts stay in this archetype as the separate stage s5 (own inputs nba.cup_format, nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state, nba.cup_finals_pair_probability and Cup data set). The 30-point comeback and 40-point Finals blowout stay in stage s4, fed by play-by-play score paths via nba.playoff_max_deficit_comeback_rate. Stage texts updated; series_assignment.json unchanged (read-only).

series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.detail: Verified on NBA.com and ESPN: for 2026-27 the higher seed hosts the semifinals (Dec 8-9), the final is neutral at Hinkle Fieldhouse (Dec 11), one wild card per conference (wild-card ties start at point differential). One NBC page said Las Vegas semifinals; NBA.com overrides it. Patched nba.cup_finals_pair_probability (semifinal home court, shared-venue copula removed) and nba.cup_format (bracket, hosts, venue) in input_patches/NBA_a.json; series_and_cup stage s5 text updated.

series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.detail: Consolidated to the existing bracket input rather than adding a duplicate: patched nba.title_path measurement as the single shared playoff bracket simulation, storing per-path series lengths, venues and advancement, seeded from nba.standings_sim paths and read by season_futures_team, series_and_cup, playoff single-game points and series cumulative points. Added nba.title_path to player_milestones stage s6 (KXNBAPLAYOFF3D) and its required_data.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u10.detail: Partly verified (NBA 2026 Shooting Stars release coverage): four teams of three (two current players plus one legend), seven designated spots in fixed order, 70-second limit, two rounds with top two to the final. Patched nba.shooting_stars_team_skill with these format fields and an explicit legend skill component (career-end rates, age discount, shrinkage). Point values and tiebreak are in the league rules PDF, which could not be reached, so the input still withholds probabilities without the point table.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.detail: Not closed. Splitting all_star_weekend_events into contest, exhibition and MVP archetypes needs new archetype keys and a series re-filing in series_assignment.json, or a new blueprint in the catalog. Neither is writable through review records or input patches. Per-series input scoping (catalog_entry and contract.series_input_scope) still carries each series' inputs, so the input coverage is intact; only the archetype mapping is unresolved.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u9.detail: Verified (2026 coverage): media panel votes after the championship game and fans count 25%; Edwards won 10 of 14 panel votes and the award covered the whole three-game tournament. Panel size beyond the 14 reported votes was not confirmed. Patched nba.asg_mvp_vote_model to a 0.75 panel / 0.25 fan blend scoped to tournament totals; added nba.allstar_fan_vote_composite as the fan-popularity input to stage s8 and its data set.

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.detail: Catalog entry relabelled by the orchestrator: label, contract_types and target now describe the only live series (KXNBAPLAYOFFPTS, any player 50+ points in any playoff game, union over games) instead of triple doubles and stat averages; the staged inputs were already attached by integrate.
